cg.body:
I ___ in this company since 2020.
*have worked
work
am working
? "Since + mốc thời gian" → hiện tại hoàn thành.

If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
*rains
will rain
rained
? Điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, will + V.

She is ___ than her sister.
*taller
more tall
tallest
? Tính từ ngắn so sánh hơn: thêm -er + than.

This museum ___ in 1850.
*was built
built
is building
? Bảo tàng không tự xây → bị động quá khứ: was + V3.

I’m not used to ___ up so early.
*getting
get
got
? Be used to + V-ing: quen với việc gì.

You ___ wear a uniform at my school. It’s a rule.
*have to
mustn’t
don’t have to
? Quy định bắt buộc → have to.

This is the man ___ helped me yesterday.
*who
which
whose
? Đại từ quan hệ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ → who.

We were watching TV when the phone ___.
*rang
was ringing
rings
? Hành động đang diễn ra (quá khứ tiếp diễn) thì một hành động khác xen vào (quá khứ đơn).

A: I’m really hungry.  B: ___ make you a sandwich.
*I’ll
I’m going
I
? Lời đề nghị quyết định ngay lúc nói → will.

There isn’t ___ milk left in the fridge.
*much
many
a few
? Milk là danh từ không đếm được → much.

He asked me where I ___.
*lived
did live
did I live
? Câu hỏi gián tiếp: không đảo ngữ, lùi thì.

I’d rather ___ at home tonight.
*stay
to stay
staying
? Would rather + động từ nguyên mẫu không "to".

By the time we arrived, the film ___.
*had started
has started
starts
? Hành động xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ → quá khứ hoàn thành.

A: I don’t like coffee.  B: ___ do I.
*Neither
So
Either
? Đồng ý với câu phủ định → Neither do I.

She’s very interested ___ learning Japanese.
*in
on
at
? Interested in + V-ing / danh từ.

l1.body:
When is the meeting now?
W: Hi Sam, it’s Jenny. Just to let you know, the meeting has been moved from Tuesday to Thursday. It’s still at ten o’clock, in room twelve. See you then.
*Thursday at 10
Tuesday at 10
Thursday at 12
? Moved from Tuesday to Thursday, still at ten o’clock; "twelve" là số phòng.

How much does Mr Lee need to pay?
M: Good morning, this is a message for Mr Lee. Your order is ready to collect. The total price is forty-five pounds fifty. We’re open until six o’clock today.
*£45.50
£54.50
£45.15
? Forty-five pounds fifty = £45.50. Chú ý phân biệt fifty và fifteen.

Where is the train station?
W: Excuse me, could you tell me where the train station is?
M: Sure. Go straight on, then turn left at the bank. The station is next to the post office.
*Next to the post office
Opposite the bank
Behind the post office
? "The station is next to the post office." Bank chỉ là chỗ rẽ trái.

Which platform will the train leave from?
M: Attention please. The eight fifteen train to Manchester will now leave from platform seven, not platform three. We apologise for any inconvenience.
*Platform 7
Platform 3
Platform 8
? Now leave from platform seven, not platform three. "Eight" là giờ tàu chạy.
l1.instr: Nghe từng đoạn và chọn đáp án đúng (số, giờ, địa điểm…). Mỗi đoạn được nghe tối đa 2 lần, giống đề thật.

l2.body:
LỰA CHỌN: To communicate at work | To visit a family member abroad | To enjoy films and entertainment | To meet a course requirement | To make friends online | To get a promotion
Speaker 1 = To communicate at work
W: I’m a nurse at a big hospital in the city centre, and a lot of my patients are tourists. I need English to explain their treatment clearly and make them feel comfortable.
Speaker 2 = To visit a family member abroad
M: My daughter is going to study in Australia next year. I want to visit her there, and I’d love to be able to chat with her flatmates and her new friends.
Speaker 3 = To enjoy films and entertainment
W: To be honest, I just love American films and TV series. My goal is to watch them without subtitles one day.
Speaker 4 = To meet a course requirement
M: I’m applying for a master’s programme, and the university says I need an English certificate before I can start. So I don’t really have a choice!

l2.title: Vì sao họ học tiếng Anh?

l3.audio:
W: I buy almost everything online these days. It’s so convenient.
M: Me too, especially books. But I still prefer to buy clothes in a shop. I need to try them on first.
W: Really? I order clothes online all the time. If they don’t fit, I just send them back.
M: Well, delivery is really fast now, isn’t it?
W: Yes, I often get things the next day. Although I do worry about all the plastic packaging.
M: Hmm, I don’t really mind. Most of it can be recycled anyway.

LỰA CHỌN: Người đàn ông | Người phụ nữ | Cả hai
Shopping online is convenient. = Cả hai
Clothes are better bought in a shop. = Người đàn ông
Deliveries arrive quickly. = Cả hai
Packaging is a problem. = Người phụ nữ
l3.instr: Nghe cuộc trò chuyện giữa một người đàn ông và một người phụ nữ. Ai có ý kiến dưới đây: người đàn ông, người phụ nữ, hay cả hai?
l3.title: Hội thoại: mua sắm online

l4.audio: M: Welcome, everyone. Starting next month, we’re going to try a four-day working week. I know some of you are worried about having more work to do each day, and to be honest, I had the same concern at first. But other companies that tried it found that staff were happier and actually got more done. So I’m quite optimistic. We’ll review everything after three months, and if it isn’t working, we’ll simply go back to the old system.
l4.body:
How does the speaker feel about the new system now?
*Hopeful
Worried
Uninterested
? "So I’m quite optimistic." Lo lắng là cảm giác lúc đầu (at first).

What is the main purpose of the talk?
*To explain a trial of a new schedule
To complain about the workload
To announce job cuts
? Công ty "try" tuần 4 ngày và sẽ "review after three months" → một đợt thử nghiệm.

r2a.body:
Getting a library card is easy.
First, fill in the application form on the library website.
After that, take the form and a photo ID to the front desk.
The staff will check your documents.
They usually print your card in just a few minutes.
Once you have it, you can borrow up to five books at a time.
r2a.instr: Câu đầu tiên đã cho sẵn. Dùng nút ↑ ↓ để sắp xếp 5 câu còn lại thành đoạn văn hợp lý. Chú ý các từ nối: First, After that, They, Once…
r2a.title: Sắp xếp câu: làm thẻ thư viện

r2b.body:
Last summer, Tom decided to learn to swim.
He found a swimming class at a pool near his house.
At the first lesson, he was very nervous.
However, the teacher was patient and kind.
Little by little, Tom became more confident in the water.
By the end of the summer, he could swim 100 metres.
r2b.instr: Câu đầu tiên đã cho sẵn. Sắp xếp 5 câu còn lại theo đúng trình tự câu chuyện.
r2b.title: Sắp xếp câu: Tom học bơi

r2c.body:
Last Saturday, our town held its first family sports day.
The day began at 8 a.m. with a five-kilometre run for adults.
More than fifty people took part in it, and the winner was a local teacher.
After the prizes were given out, it was the children's turn to compete.
Their events included running, jumping and a short swimming race.
At the end, everyone was tired and hungry, so the organisers served a big picnic lunch.
r2c.instr: Câu đầu tiên đã cho sẵn. Dùng nút ↑ ↓ để sắp xếp 5 câu còn lại. Chú ý từ nối (Then, After, As a result…) và từ thay thế (this, they, it).
r2c.title: Sắp xếp câu: ngày hội thể thao

r2d.body:
The first films were made more than a hundred years ago.
At that time, films were very different from the ones we watch today.
For example, they had no colour and no sound.
Besides these technical problems, film makers also had very little money.
This lack of money meant that actors were paid very small salaries.
Today, however, the most famous actors earn millions of dollars for a single film.
r2d.instr: Câu đầu tiên đã cho sẵn. Dùng nút ↑ ↓ để sắp xếp 5 câu còn lại. Chú ý từ nối (Then, After, As a result…) và từ thay thế (this, they, it).
r2d.title: Sắp xếp câu: phim thời xưa

r2e.body:
For most of history, long journeys were difficult and expensive.
Only rich people could afford to travel far from home.
Then the arrival of trains, and later cars, made travel cheaper for everyone.
After these two inventions, the aeroplane made travelling even easier.
Because flying is so fast, millions of people now go abroad for holidays and business.
As a result, visiting another part of the world is now part of many people's lives.
r2e.instr: Câu đầu tiên đã cho sẵn. Dùng nút ↑ ↓ để sắp xếp 5 câu còn lại. Chú ý từ nối (Then, After, As a result…) và từ thay thế (this, they, it).
r2e.title: Sắp xếp câu: lịch sử đi lại

r3.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Anna | Ben | Carla | David
Who now spends less money? = Anna
Who has trouble focusing at home? = Ben
Who believes employees should make the decision? = David
Who does more exercise than before? = Carla
Who misses informal conversations at work? = Anna
Who thinks advice from a boss is better in person? = Ben
Who already works partly at home and partly in the office? = David
r3.instr: Đọc ý kiến của 4 người. Chọn người phù hợp với mỗi câu. Một người có thể được chọn nhiều lần.
r3.intro:
Anna: Working from home has saved me a lot of money. I used to spend almost a quarter of my salary on train tickets and lunches in the city. Now I cook at home. The only thing I miss is chatting with colleagues at the coffee machine.

Ben: I find it hard to concentrate at home. My children are noisy and there’s always housework waiting for me. I prefer going to the office, where I can focus. Also, my manager gives better feedback face to face.

Carla: For me, the biggest advantage is time. My journey to work used to take two hours a day. Now I use that time to go running in the morning, and I feel much healthier than before.

David: I think companies should let workers choose. Some jobs need people in the same room, others don’t. My team comes in twice a week for meetings and works at home the rest of the time. It works well for everyone.
r3.title: Ghép ý kiến: làm việc tại nhà

r4.body:
LỰA CHỌN: A solution born from a lack of space | Benefits for body and mind | Bringing neighbours together | Lessons for young learners | Problems that city gardeners face | Help from local authorities | A green future | The high cost of buying land
In many large cities there is very little space for nature. Most people live in apartments without a garden, and parks are often crowded. Because of this, a growing number of residents have started to grow vegetables and flowers on rooftops, balconies and empty pieces of land. What began as a hobby for a few people has become a movement in cities from London to Hanoi. = A solution born from a lack of space
Doctors say that gardening is good for both the body and the mind. Digging, planting and carrying water are gentle forms of exercise, and spending time outdoors can reduce stress. Many urban gardeners also eat more fresh vegetables, simply because they grow them themselves and want to enjoy the results of their hard work. = Benefits for body and mind
Urban gardens are also changing the way people relate to each other. In a typical city building, people may live next door for years without speaking. A shared garden gives them a reason to meet. They swap seeds, share tools and give advice, and some groups organise meals together at harvest time. = Bringing neighbours together
Schools have noticed these benefits too. Several primary schools now have their own vegetable beds, where pupils learn where their food comes from. Teachers say that children who have grown a tomato are much more willing to eat one, and that gardening helps them understand science topics such as plant life and the weather. = Lessons for young learners
However, gardening in the city is not always easy. Air pollution can affect plants, and rooftops are often windy and extremely hot in summer. Water can also be a problem, as carrying it up several floors is hard work. Some gardeners have given up after their plants were damaged or even stolen. = Problems that city gardeners face
In some places, city councils have decided to help. They offer free training courses, give away seeds and allow residents to use empty public land for a small fee. A few cities have even changed their building rules so that new apartment blocks must include space for a roof garden. = Help from local authorities
Experts believe that urban gardening will continue to grow. As cities become hotter and more crowded, green spaces will be more important than ever. These small gardens cannot feed a whole city, but they show that even in a concrete jungle, people still want to stay connected to nature. = A green future
r4.instr: Chọn tiêu đề phù hợp cho mỗi đoạn. Có 8 tiêu đề cho 7 đoạn, một tiêu đề thừa. Bài thật dài khoảng 750 từ; bài này ngắn hơn.
r4.title: Ghép tiêu đề: vườn rau trong thành phố

s1.body:
CÂU HỎI: Please tell me about your family. | 30
CÂU HỎI: What do you usually do at the weekend? | 30
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about the place where you live. | 30
CỤM TỪ: There are … people in my family. | I usually … because … | What I like most about … is … | It’s quite / really …
BÀI MẪU: There are four people in my family: my parents, my younger brother and me. My father is an engineer and my mother is a teacher. We often have dinner together and talk about our day.
s1.instr: Trả lời 3 câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 30 giây. Nói 3–4 câu cho mỗi câu hỏi.
s1.title: Câu hỏi về bản thân

s2.body:
ẢNH: Một nhóm bạn trẻ đang cùng nấu ăn trong một căn bếp nhỏ. Có rau và thịt trên bàn, mọi người đang cười.
CÂU HỎI: Describe this picture. | 45
CÂU HỎI: Do you enjoy cooking? Why or why not? | 45
CÂU HỎI: Why do some people prefer eating out to cooking at home? | 45
CỤM TỪ: In this picture, I can see … | In the background / foreground … | They seem to be … | It looks like … | I think the main reason is that …
BÀI MẪU: In this picture, I can see a group of young people cooking together in a small kitchen. There are some vegetables and meat on the table. They seem to be very happy because they are all laughing. It looks like they are preparing a meal for a party.
s2.instr: Mô tả bức ảnh rồi trả lời 2 câu hỏi khó dần. Mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây.
s2.part: Part 2 · Describe, express opinion, give reasons
s2.title: Mô tả một bức ảnh

s3.body:
ẢNH: Ảnh 1: Một người đang đọc sách giấy trong thư viện yên tĩnh.
ẢNH: Ảnh 2: Một người đang đọc sách trên máy tính bảng khi ngồi trên xe buýt đông người.
CÂU HỎI: Tell me what you see in the two pictures. | 45
CÂU HỎI: Which way of reading would you prefer? Why? | 45
CÂU HỎI: Do you think paper books will disappear in the future? | 45
CỤM TỪ: Both pictures show … | In the first picture …, whereas in the second … | One difference is that … | I would rather … because … | On the other hand, …
BÀI MẪU: Both pictures show people reading. In the first picture, a woman is reading a paper book in a quiet library, whereas in the second picture, a man is reading on a tablet on a busy bus. One difference is that the library looks calm and comfortable, while the bus looks crowded and noisy.
s3.instr: Mô tả và so sánh hai bức ảnh, rồi trả lời 2 câu hỏi. Mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây.
s3.title: So sánh hai bức ảnh

s4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about a time when you learned a new skill.
CÂU HỎI: How did you feel while you were learning it?
CÂU HỎI: Why is it important for adults to keep learning?
CHUẨN BỊ: 60
NÓI: 120
CỤM TỪ: I’d like to talk about the time when … | At first I felt …, but later … | In my opinion, … | For example, … | To sum up, …
BÀI MẪU: I’d like to talk about the time when I learned to drive a car, about three years ago. At first I felt very nervous, because the roads in my city are always busy. However, my teacher was patient, and after a few weeks I became more confident. In my opinion, it is important for adults to keep learning because the world changes very quickly. For example, new technology appears every year, and if we do not learn, we can fall behind at work. Learning also keeps our minds active and makes life more interesting. To sum up, learning new skills is useful at any age.
s4.instr: Đọc 3 câu hỏi. Bạn có 1 phút chuẩn bị (được ghi chú), sau đó nói 2 phút trả lời cả 3 câu trong một lượt.

w1.body:
CÂU HỎI: What’s your favourite season?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Summer.

CÂU HỎI: Where do you usually go on holiday?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: To the beach.

CÂU HỎI: Who do you usually travel with?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: My family.

CÂU HỎI: How do you get to work or school?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: By motorbike.

CÂU HỎI: What food do you like?
SỐ TỪ: 1-5
BÀI MẪU: Vietnamese street food.
w1.instr: Bạn vừa tham gia **câu lạc bộ du lịch**. Trả lời mỗi tin nhắn bằng 1–5 từ. Nên làm xong trong khoảng 3 phút.
w1.title: Trả lời 5 tin nhắn ngắn

w2.body:
CÂU HỎI: Please tell us why you want to join the travel club.
SỐ TỪ: 20-30
BÀI MẪU: I want to join the travel club to explore new places. I love travelling because it helps me relax. For example, last summer I visited Sa Pa with friends.
w2.instr: Trả lời câu hỏi của câu lạc bộ bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, 20–30 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 7 phút.
w2.title: Viết 20–30 từ

w3.body:
NGƯỜI HỎI: Lucy
CÂU HỎI: Hi! What was the best trip you have ever taken?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi Lucy! My best trip was to Sa Pa two years ago with my close friends. I loved it because the weather was cool and the views were amazing. For example, we walked through beautiful rice fields.

NGƯỜI HỎI: Mark
CÂU HỎI: Do you prefer travelling alone or in a group? Why?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi Mark! I prefer travelling in a group rather than alone. I like it because it is safer and more fun. I also save money because we can share the cost of hotels and taxis.

NGƯỜI HỎI: Sara
CÂU HỎI: What advice would you give someone visiting your country for the first time?
SỐ TỪ: 30-40
BÀI MẪU: Hi Sara! I would suggest trying the street food when you visit Vietnam. I recommend it because it is cheap and delicious. I also think you should learn a few Vietnamese words before you come.
w3.instr: Các thành viên hỏi bạn trong nhóm chat của câu lạc bộ. Trả lời mỗi người 30–40 từ. Nên làm trong khoảng 10 phút.
w3.title: Trả lời 3 câu hỏi trong nhóm chat

w4.body:
CÂU HỎI: Viết email cho **một người bạn** cũng là thành viên câu lạc bộ: nói cảm nghĩ của bạn về thay đổi này và bạn định làm gì. (40–50 từ, văn phong thân mật)
SỐ TỪ: 40-50
BÀI MẪU: Hi Nam,
I'm really disappointed about the change to our mountain trip.
I think it would be better to wait for good weather and go hiking later.
I'm considering not joining the museum visit, especially at the higher price.
What do you think?
Talk soon,
Linh

CÂU HỎI: Viết email cho **người quản lý câu lạc bộ**: nói cảm nghĩ của bạn về thay đổi và đưa ra đề xuất. (120–150 từ, văn phong trang trọng)
SỐ TỪ: 120-150
BÀI MẪU: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to share my thoughts about the recent change to the club's weekend trip. I understand that safety comes first, but I am rather disappointed about the new plan.
I would like to suggest postponing the mountain trip instead of replacing it. I believe this is fairer because most members joined the trip to spend time outdoors, not in museums. However, the 20% price increase is quite high, especially as members were told about it at the last minute.
If postponing the trip is not possible, we could keep the original price for the city visit or offer a full refund to members who do not wish to take part. I also suggest asking members to vote on future destinations so that everyone feels involved.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Tran Thi Linh
w4.instr: Đọc thông báo từ câu lạc bộ, sau đó viết 2 email. Phần này dùng hết thời gian còn lại (khoảng 30 phút).
w4.intro:
Email từ câu lạc bộ: Dear member,
We are sorry to tell you that, because of bad weather forecasts, the club’s weekend trip to the mountains has been changed. It will now be a two-day visit to museums in the city. The price will also increase by 20% because of hotel costs.
w4.title: Viết 2 email

lt1-p1.title: Nghe và chọn chi tiết
lt1-p1.instr: Nghe từng đoạn và chọn đáp án đúng. Mỗi đoạn được nghe tối đa 2 lần.
lt1-p1.body:
A person calls a friend about his new car. How much does the small car cost him?
AUDIO: audio/q1.mp3
W: Hey, I just wanted to tell you about my new car! It's a small one, perfect for my needs. I got it for a great price - only 3,250 pounds! Can you believe it? I was looking at bigger models too, but they were way more expensive, around 3,550 pounds or even 4,250 pounds. I'm really happy with my choice!
*3250 pounds
3550 pounds
4250 pounds

Two people are talking about meeting for dinner. What time does Ahmed meet Rose?
AUDIO: audio/q2.mp3
W: Hi Rose. It's Ahmed, what time should we meet for dinner tonight? How about we meet at quarter past seven instead? Oh wait, I just remembered - I have a meeting ending at half past seven. Let's make it quarter to eight instead so we could have 15 minutes to travel.
half past seven
quarter past seven
*quarter to eight

A man calls the teleshop. What is the teleshop number?
AUDIO: audio/q3.mp3
W: Hello, I need to call the teleshop for some information. My phone is not working. Can you remind me of the number? I think it starts with 20 or 10 or 30 something. Is it 102030 or 301020? No, wait! I remember now it's 201030!
102030
*201030
301020

A man is talking to a shopping assistant. What color top is he going to buy?
AUDIO: audio/q4.mp3
M: I like the design of that green one over there. Do you have it in blue?
W: We have that one in blue but small. The red and black ones, however, are available in large.
M: Red is not my cup of tea. Well, I will go with the other option then. (→ Black, large)
Green
Blue
*Black

Anna is calling her brother Max. What does Anna do later in the afternoon?
AUDIO: audio/q5.mp3
W: Anna: I want to ask you for a favor this afternoon. I have to stay late at the office to finish some work. Could you please pick up my kids from school? After that, I know you'll want to hang out with your friends.
*Stay late at the office
Pick up her kids
Hang out with friends

Vincent is calling James. Why does Vincent call James?
AUDIO: audio/q6.mp3
W: Hi James, it's Vincent. I just want to check in and see how you're doing. How about we grab a drink later? I know a great new place that has very nice tea.
To say hello
*To suggest a drink
To arrange meeting

A man is talking about his trip. What did he enjoy last year?
AUDIO: audio/q7.mp3
W: Last year, I had an amazing trip! One of the best things I enjoyed was going cycling in the countryside. I also went for a walk a few times, but cycling really allowed me to explore more areas. We even had a picnic one day too.
Go for a walk
Go picnic
*Go cycling

A woman is talking about her job. What encouraged her to become a scientist?
AUDIO: audio/q8.mp3
W: I remember when I was a child, I found a large stone during a school trip. It sparked my curiosity about geology. My mother also inspired me to explore my interests in science, but that stone was the beginning.
Her mother
*A large stone
The computer

A man is talking about the city concert. How will the concert end?
AUDIO: audio/q9.mp3
W: The highlight ending will be the city's favorite group performing on stage. There will also be a fireworks performance before that, and the orchestra will do some singing as well.
*The city's favorite group
Fireworks performance
Singing from orchestra

A man is talking about his family trip. What does the man's wife enjoy?
AUDIO: audio/q10.mp3
W: My wife really enjoys photography. When we went walking together in the parks, she spent a lot of time taking pictures of the beautiful landscapes. At least she is not crazy about shopping.
walking
shopping
*photography

Jana is talking to her friend. What does Jana's sister look like?
AUDIO: audio/q11.mp3
W: She's the one who is short and has straight hair, so you can't miss her. I also think she's wearing a blue jacket today.
Curly hair
*Short
Thin

A man is calling his sister. Where are they going to meet?
AUDIO: audio/q12.mp3
W: I thought we agreed to meet at the park, right? The station would be too crowded, and the university is a bit far for me. Let's stick to the park.
At the university
At the station
*At the park

A woman is talking about her vacation. What is the relationship between the speaker and Lisa?
AUDIO: audio/q13.mp3
W: We've been friends for years, and this trip really brought us closer. Some people think we look like mother and daughter, but it's really just best friends hanging out!
*Best friends
Mother and daughter
Teacher and student

lt1-p2.title: Ghép người nói
lt1-p2.instr: Four people are talking about their exercise preferences. Match each speaker with the activity they enjoy.
lt1-p2.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Horse riding | Mountain biking | Walking | Going for a run
Speaker A = Mountain biking
AUDIO: audio/q14_1.mp3
W: I find nothing more exciting than mountain biking. I love the challenge of rough terrains and feeling the wind rush by as I go downhill.
Speaker B = Going for a run
AUDIO: audio/q14_2.mp3
W: I've found that I get the most out of a good jog. I usually jog around the park or along the river near my home.
Speaker C = Walking
AUDIO: audio/q14_3.mp3
W: I find walking to be the perfect balance for me. It allows me to relax while still staying active.
Speaker D = Horse riding
AUDIO: audio/q14_4.mp3
W: One thing that stands out for me is horse riding. There's something about being with horses that feels both calming and exciting.

lt1-p3.title: Ai có ý kiến này?
lt1-p3.instr: Listen to two people discussing the Internet. Decide whose opinion matches each statement: the man, the woman, or both. You can listen twice.
lt1-p3.audio:
AUDIO: audio/q15.mp3
W: I really feel there's too much information on the Internet.
M: Finding what we need online requires certain skills.
M: I believe the Internet affects the way we think.
W: ...the constant scrolling and quick answers can make young people less patient.
M: Exactly! (both agree)
lt1-p3.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Man | Woman | Both
There is too much information on the Internet = Woman
Finding information on the Internet requires skills = Both
The use of internet affects the way we think = Man
The internet makes young people less patient = Both

lt1-p4a.title: Bài nói 1
lt1-p4a.instr: Listen to an announcer talking about a newly released novel.
lt1-p4a.audio:
AUDIO: audio/q16.mp3
W: Parker's new novel Shadow in the Night is quite different from his earlier romantic stories - it's a thriller. The announcer believes it's important for Parker to pay attention to critics' advice as he works on his next book.
lt1-p4a.body:
What does the announcer say about the new novel?
*It is different from his earlier works
It is romantic and soft
It is less famous than his earlier works

What does the announcer say the writer should do in the future?
The writer should continue to write this genre
The writer should go back to his original genre
*He should listen to critics before writing his next work

lt1-p4b.title: Bài nói 2
lt1-p4b.instr: Listen to an expert talking about professionalism.
lt1-p4b.audio:
AUDIO: audio/q17.mp3
W: An optimistic attitude not only makes a good impression but also creates a better work environment. Our definition of professionalism is no longer the same as it was 40 years ago - it now includes being adaptable and using technology effectively.
lt1-p4b.body:
What does the expert say being professional is all about?
*To maintain positive attitude
To create good working environment
To make good impressions

What does the expert say about the definition of professionalism?
It is the same as 40 years ago
*Our definition of it is changing
It will not change anymore

lt2-p1.title: Nghe và chọn chi tiết
lt2-p1.instr: Nghe từng đoạn và chọn đáp án đúng. Mỗi đoạn được nghe tối đa 2 lần.
lt2-p1.body:
A woman is talking about her house. What is she going to change in their house?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q1.mp3
W: I've always loved the ocean, that is why I initially wanted to install a big window that looks out to the river at my house. But now my husband and I realized it was too big and now too much sunshine got in. My car got heated and the computer next to the window always seemed like it would explode. I have no choice but to change it into another window that can close entirely.
*The window
The car
The computer

A receptionist is checking the client list of a clinic. How many clients are Americans?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q2.mp3
W: Receptionist: Alright, let me go over the list of clients for today. We've got Carl, Harry, and Matthew, all from the UK. Leslie, who's from the US, is also scheduled for an appointment. Then, we have two more clients coming in from France. So that gives us one American, a few from the UK, and the rest from France.
*One
Two
Three

Listen to Anna talking about her routine. Where does Anna go for a walk every morning?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q3.mp3
W: I really like to walk in the mornings. Every day, I take a nice walk before my classes start. I could walk around my neighborhood, but I prefer going to college. It's a great way for me to get a bit of exercise and clear my mind before the day begins.
park
neighborhood
*college

Listen to a girl calling the cafe. What did she forget, and where did she leave it?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q4.mp3
W: Hi, I was at your cafe this afternoon, and I think I left something there. I remember having it when I sat at a small table in the corner. I checked the counter and near the door before I left, but I must have forgotten it in the corner after all. Could you please look there?
on the counter
*in the corner
near the door

Helen is calling a friend about the place her whole family is standing while seeing her off to college. Where are they standing?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q5.mp3
W: Hi! I just wanted to call quickly before we head off. My family is all here to see me, and we're standing in this big area with lots of houses and apartments. It's a nice residential area, with some trees and small shops nearby. We're not right by the university, but it's close enough.
library complex
university area
*Residential area

A tour guide is talking about the vacation list of activities. What can people do in the afternoon?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q6.mp3
M: Now, let's talk about the afternoon activities. For those interested, we have a golf course available where you can spend your afternoon playing golf. If golf isn't your thing, don't worry, there's also a dance class scheduled in the evening. And of course, you can always go shopping in the nearby stores later on, but bear in mind, the store will only open in the morning.
Join a dance class
*Play golf
Go shopping

Doctor's office is calling about a change in the appointment. When is the new appointment?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q7.mp3
W: Hello! This is the doctor's office calling to change your appointment. I wanted to let you know that the new appointment is on Thursday the 13th. I understand you might have been expecting it to be on Friday the 14th, but we're all off this day due to the national dentist holiday.
*On Thursday 13th
On Thursday 30th
On Friday 14th

Alice is calling her friend. What did she lose?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q8.mp3
W: Hey, it's Alice. I think I might have left something at your house. I had my book with me. It's in my backpack. My laptop's here too. But I can't find my phone anywhere! Did you happen to see it after I left?
A book
A laptop
*A phone

Max is calling his friend. How much can Max pay for the computer?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q9.mp3
W: Hi. It's me Max. I'm calling about the computer that you are selling. My computer is old and slow. I can't play any games on it anymore and would like to replace it with a new one. How much do you offer? I can pay 250 pounds. This afternoon I am busy but we can discuss this tomorrow morning, is that okay?
150 pounds
*250 pounds
350 pounds

Listen to a man talking about their train journey. What time did the train depart?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q10.mp3
W: This morning was rough at the station. I thought the train would leave around 9:00, but I heard it would be delayed. It finally departed at 9:30, though some people said it might be even later. Usually, if it's delayed, it could leave as late as 10:00.
9:00
*9:30
10:00

Listen to a woman asking about a flight. How much does the flight in the morning cost?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q11.mp3
W: I'm looking at flights and comparing prices. The morning flight I want is 350 pounds, which is a bit more than the 300-pound one later in the day. There's also another option that costs 400 pounds, but it includes extra services I don't need. So, I think I'll stick with the 350-pound one since it leaves at the right time for me.
300 pounds
*350 pounds
400 pounds

Listen to a friend talking about selling her music player. How much did she sell it for?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q12.mp3
W: I sold my old music player last week. I considered selling it for around 60 dollars since it was in good condition, but I thought 40 dollars would be a bit too low. I finally sold it for 50 dollars, which felt just right. Now, I have a bit of extra cash to save or spend on something new.
*50 dollars
60 dollars
40 dollars

Listen to a woman explaining why she was late. What is the main reason she gets late?
AUDIO: audio/t2_q13.mp3
W: I've been late several times recently. Sometimes, I oversleep, but that wasn't the case today. I actually left on time, but I missed the train at the last minute. It's always the main reason I end up late. I try to double-check everything I need, so forgetting something isn't usually an issue for me either.
Overslept
Forgot something
*Missed the train

lt2-p2.title: Ghép người nói
lt2-p2.instr: Four people are talking about doing exercises. Match each speaker with what they say about it.
lt2-p2.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Have fun exercising with others | Improve work performance | Hate exercising | Find exercise tiring
Speaker A = Improve work performance
AUDIO: audio/t2_q14_1.mp3
W: Exercise has become essential in my life, especially with my demanding and stressful job. It helps me release stress and clear my mind, and I feel more focused, energized, and ready to tackle my work with renewed vigor. It greatly improves my work performance.
Speaker B = Find exercise tiring
AUDIO: audio/t2_q14_2.mp3
W: Exercise wears me out. The idea of getting all sweaty and sore doesn't excite me at all. Every time I try to work out, it feels like I'm running on empty within minutes. Exercise for me is just exhausting.
Speaker C = Have fun exercising with others
AUDIO: audio/t2_q14_3.mp3
W: Exercising is a blast when you're with the right people! I've joined a few group classes, and they're like a party every time. Working out alone can get boring, but with friends, you laugh, you encourage each other. The camaraderie makes it worth every minute.
Speaker D = Hate exercising
AUDIO: audio/t2_q14_4.mp3
W: Exercise? Ugh, I can't stand it. I know it's supposed to be 'good for you', but I find it completely miserable. The sweat, the strain, the way my muscles burn afterward - it's like a punishment. I still hate it.

lt2-p3.title: Ai có ý kiến này?
lt2-p3.instr: Listen to two people discussing Politics. Decide whose opinion matches each statement: the man, the woman, or both. You can listen twice.
lt2-p3.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t2_q15.mp3
W: I've noticed that young people are becoming much more interested in politics lately.
M: I completely agree!
W: I also think social media plays a big role in this.
M: Actually I believe people are becoming better informed about politics not because of social media but through traditional news sources.
M: It's also encouraging to see more women pursuing careers in politics.
W: Absolutely! More representation is always a positive step forward.
lt2-p3.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Man | Woman | Both
Young people are more into politics = Both
Social media change politics. = Woman
People are now better informed on politic. = Man
More women pursuit politics. = Both

lt2-p4a.title: Bài nói 1
lt2-p4a.instr: Listen to a writer talking about her experience in writing.
lt2-p4a.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t2_q16.mp3
W: Many people think that to write well, you need to sit down every day for 15 to 20 minutes or find a quiet space. I've found that establishing specific time slots for writing that truly fit my style is what helps me the most. I did face significant writer's block, and I regret not reaching out for guidance from others. Talking to fellow writers and mentors could have helped me overcome that block much faster.
lt2-p4a.body:
What does the writer believe helps her the most in her writing process?
Writing every day for 15-20 minutes
*Create dedicated periods for writing
Finding a quiet space to work

What does the writer regret doing during her experience with writer's block?
*Refuse to seek advice of others
Ignoring feedback from editors
Writing without a plan

lt2-p4b.title: Bài nói 2
lt2-p4b.instr: The radio is talking about a musician's career and latest albums.
lt2-p4b.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t2_q17.mp3
W: Today, we're diving into the life of a beloved musician who has decided to retire from singing professionally. This time he's serious about stepping away for good. Many believe he could have achieved even greater success with his recent albums. However, the long break he took between projects made it difficult for him to regain his previous momentum.
lt2-p4b.body:
What has the musician decided regarding his singing career?
*He will retire from singing professionally
He will make a comeback after a long break
He will inform fans about new albums

What could the musician have achieved with his recent albums?
*He could have been more successful
He could have inspired future generations in general.
He could have gotten a bigger fan base.

lt3-p1.title: Nghe và chọn chi tiết
lt3-p1.instr: Nghe từng đoạn và chọn đáp án đúng. Mỗi đoạn được nghe tối đa 2 lần.
lt3-p1.body:
A mom is calling her son to remind him about picking up groceries. How much is an egg?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q1.mp3
W: Hey sweetie, it's Mom! Can you please pick up three things on your way home? I need a dozen eggs, they're one pound fifty each. Also, grab a loaf of bread and some milk, please. Thanks, love you!
*£1.50 (One pounds fifty)
£2.50 (Two pounds fifty)
£3.50 (Three pounds fifty)

An author is talking about her daily routine. When does she usually write?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q2.mp3
W: Every morning, I start my day by going for a run. After lunch, at around two o'clock, I sit down at my working table, ready to write. My husband is my best critic, so I try to produce something before he gets home in the afternoon. At night, I seek motivation by watching movies or reading books.
In the mornings
*In the afternoons
In the evenings

Jack is calling to invite a friend to his house. What color is Jack's house?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q3.mp3
W: Hey! It's Jack. I just moved to a new house in this busy neighborhood, and it's really cool! There are so many houses here in different colors - purple, blue, and white. My house is big and red! I'd love for you to come over and check it out.
Blue
Green
*Red

A man is calling his wife. Where will they meet?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q4.mp3
W: Hi honey, it's me! Just a reminder that the train leaves at 5, so you should arrive around 6 o'clock. I'll be there to pick you up at the train station. Let's meet outside the shop opposite the station. I can't wait to have dinner together!
At home
In the garden
*Outside the shop

A man is talking about his eating habit. What time does he usually eat?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q5.mp3
W: I usually have dinner every evening. It's become a habit for me to enjoy a meal at that time after a long day. I find it's the perfect time to unwind and relax. We usually have dinner at 7 o'clock and it is definitely my favorite meal of the day!
6 o'clock
*7 o'clock
8 o'clock

Julie is asking her professor about the assignment. When is the work due?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q6.mp3
W: Julie: I wanted to ask about the assignment. Is it possible to get an extension until Friday? I have a lot of work lately, so I can't complete it by Thursday. Professor: Actually, all assignments need to be submitted by Saturday morning, so you have two more days.
On Thursday morning
On Friday morning
*On Saturday morning

James is talking about his family members. In what way does his mother and his aunt alike?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q7.mp3
W: This picture is of my aunt and my mom. When they were teenagers, my mom had long hair, while my aunt had short hair. They were both equally thin back then, but their eyes were different. My mom has lovely brown eyes, and my aunt has strikingly beautiful blue eyes.
*They were both thin
They both had blue eyes.
They both had long hair

A tour guide is introducing a tourist destination. How many people live in the town?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q8.mp3
W: Welcome, everyone! Today, I'm excited to introduce you to our charming small town. This square is the heart of our community. Currently, there are 10,000 people living in this town. As we explore, you'll see the unique blend of history and modern life that makes our town so special.
8,000
9,000
*10,000

A man and a woman are talking about their old school days. What was the man's favorite thing about school?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q9.mp3
W: I remember that I was terrible at math! Also, I remember that you were really good at history.
M: That's right! I loved history. Actually, those classes were the ones I remember the most. All those stories and events were so fascinating!
Math classes
Geography classes
*History classes

Jorge is calling his friend about their plan for the weekend. What time does the football match start?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q10.mp3
W: Hey, it's Jorge! I'll be busy in the morning, but how about we meet at 11:30 for lunch? The football match starts at 1 p.m., and since it takes about 30 minutes to drive there, we'll have just enough time to grab something to eat.
11 p.m
*1 p.m
6 p.m

A man is talking about his routine after work. What is the man going to do after work?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q11.mp3
W: After work, I'm usually exhausted because my job can be really tough. I always look forward to 5 o'clock, so I can finally check out and head home. I like to go for a run after work to clear my mind and shake off the stress. It helps me feel refreshed and ready for the next day.
*Goes running
Cycles home
Meets his client

A professor is talking to his student. What does the professor ask his student to do?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q12.mp3
W: Professor: I've just finished reading your thesis, and I must say, it's very well done. I actually think you should consider presenting it at the upcoming student conference. Student: Wow, really? That sounds exciting!
*Speak at a conference
Write another thesis
Tutor another student

Two friends are talking about their favorite activities. What is the woman's favorite form of entertainment?
AUDIO: audio/t3_q13.mp3
M: Hey, what's your favorite activity?
W: I'd probably say watching films. It's so much fun!
M: Where do you like to watch them?
W: I really enjoy going to the theatre. It's my favorite form of entertainment.
Reading books
*Going to the theatre
Playing chess with her cousin

lt3-p2.title: Ghép người nói
lt3-p2.instr: Four people are talking about protecting the environment. Match each speaker with what they say.
lt3-p2.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Using less electricity | Using less water | Shopping online | Not driving to work
Speaker A = Using less electricity
AUDIO: audio/t3_q14_1.mp3
W: I try to help the environment by using less electricity at home. I always turn off the lights when I don't need them and make sure my appliances are energy-efficient. I've also started unplugging things like chargers when I'm not using them.
Speaker B = Not driving to work
AUDIO: audio/t3_q14_2.mp3
W: To protect the environment, I don't drive to work anymore. Instead, I walk when the weather is nice, or I take the bus. By not driving, I use less fuel and help reduce air pollution in the city.
Speaker C = Shopping online
AUDIO: audio/t3_q14_3.mp3
W: I've decided to shop online as a way to protect the environment. By ordering things online, I don't need to drive to the store, which means I'm using less fuel and producing less pollution. Many companies now offer eco-friendly packaging.
Speaker D = Using less water
AUDIO: audio/t3_q14_4.mp3
W: I try to save water every day as a way to protect the environment. For example, I take shorter showers, turn off the tap while brushing my teeth, and use less water when washing dishes. I've also installed special taps and showerheads.

lt3-p3.title: Ai có ý kiến này?
lt3-p3.instr: Two professional educators are talking about university. Decide whose opinion matches each statement: the man, the woman, or both. You can listen twice.
lt3-p3.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t3_q15.mp3
W: I think we can both agree that the internet has made education more accessible.
M: But I still believe that social interactions are a crucial part of university life.
M: Another thing I'm really in favor of is encouraging competition between universities.
W: To be honest, I'm not a fan of having too many options in the curriculum. A diverse curriculum can overwhelm students.
lt3-p3.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Man | Woman | Both
The internet makes education more accessible = Both
Social interactions are essential to university life = Man
A diverse curriculum is not always a good thing = Woman
Competitions between universities should be encouraged = Man

lt3-p4a.title: Bài nói 1
lt3-p4a.instr: Listen to an office worker talking about working from home.
lt3-p4a.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t3_q16.mp3
W: However, working from home is not as good as I expected. I sometimes feel lonely without the social interaction from the office. After all, how well you work from home really depends on your situation and personality. Some people thrive in this environment, while others struggle.
lt3-p4a.body:
What does she say about working at home?
There are no distractions
*Not good as expected
Video calls are superior to face-to-face conversation

According to the author, working from home:
Needs a big home office
Do not require self-motivation.
*It depends on your situation and personality

lt3-p4b.title: Bài nói 2
lt3-p4b.instr: Listen to an expert talking about the importance of sleep.
lt3-p4b.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t3_q17.mp3
W: What everyone agrees on, and what studies show, is that blocking out light and noise can help improve sleep quality. Darkness helps our body produce melatonin while silence allows us to rest better. What we can agree on is that the media tends to overemphasize the subject, making it seem more serious than it really is.
lt3-p4b.body:
The most important thing to help sleep well is:
*Blocking noise and light is the key
Beds are best for sleeping
Resting sufficiently is necessary

According to the expert, what is the public attitude towards sleeping?
*The media overemphasize the subject
The young generation tends to have unhealthy sleeping habits.
Sleeping quality has deteriorated over time.

lt4-p1.title: Nghe và chọn chi tiết
lt4-p1.instr: Nghe từng đoạn và chọn đáp án đúng. Mỗi đoạn được nghe tối đa 2 lần.
lt4-p1.body:
A man is calling his friend, Maria. When will he see her?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q1.mp3
W: Hey Maria, it's me! I wanted to let you know that I'll be visiting your town this weekend. But the best part? I'll finally get to see you! I'll be at your place at 9 a.m. on Sunday, so we can catch up. Can't wait to hang out!
*at 9 am on Sunday
at 10 am on Saturday
at 8 am on Sunday

A man is calling his colleague about a meeting with clients. When will the meeting start?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q2.mp3
W: Hey, just wanted to give you a quick heads-up. I won't be able to join the meeting with the clients at 10:15 like we planned - I've got something that suddenly came up. Could you go ahead and handle the presentation on your own?
at 9.15
*at 10.15
at 11.15

A customer is calling the hotline of a department store. Which number to press in order to buy a computer?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q3.mp3
W: Thank you for calling our customer service hotline. To file a complaint about a recent purchase, please press 1. For assistance with maintenance or repairs, press 2. If you'd like a free consultation on buying a new computer, press 3.
One
Two
*Three

An expert is talking about the lack of satisfaction at work. What should be the solution?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q4.mp3
W: Many people feel unhappy at work, and often, they think a higher salary or less work will fix it. But that's not always the solution. One option is to ask for a transfer to another branch within the same company. This can offer the same benefits as getting a new job, without the challenges of starting over somewhere new.
Raise the salary
Seek a new job
*Request a transfer

A man is talking to his friend. Why does he need to learn to drive?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q5.mp3
M: I'm moving to a new place. It's actually pretty far from my workplace, and the public transport there isn't great. So, I've been thinking, I need to learn how to drive.
W: That makes sense.
He lost his driving license.
*He has to drive to work
He bought a new car.

A tour guide is talking about birds' behaviors. What do birds do in the winter?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q6.mp3
W: In spring, birds are busy building nests and finding mates. During summer, they're focused on feeding their chicks. As autumn approaches, many birds begin to migrate. In winter, birds tend to stay together in groups for protection from predators.
*Stay together for group protection
Building nests
Migrate to a new place

Two friends are talking about their school days. What was the woman good at?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q7.mp3
M: You were on the football team, right?
W: Yeah, I played for the school team. Those were some of my best memories!
M: I wasn't great at football, but I was pretty good at swimming.
W: Swimming was totally your strength. Just like football was mine.
Swimming
*Plays football
Running

Pierre and Emma are talking together about the picnic on the weekend. What will they bring to the picnic?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q8.mp3
W: Emma: So, what should we bring? Maybe some food in case we might get hungry? Pierre: That's a good idea. How about we prepare some chicken and french fries? Emma: Perfect! This picnic is going to be amazing!
Drinks
Salads
*Food

A tour guide is talking about the group's traveling schedule. Where will the group wait for the bus?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q9.mp3
W: Finally, at 8:00 PM, we'll meet at the hotel's main entrance to catch the bus to the airport. Make sure to be on time, and we'll head to the airport together!
by the hotel's side entrance
behind the hotel's main entrance
*by the hotel's main entrance

Listen to the announcement from a travel agent representative. Why is the air travel cancelled?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q10.mp3
W: Unfortunately, due to poor weather conditions, our flight has been cancelled. I know this isn't the news you were hoping for, but your safety comes first. That said, we do have alternatives available - trains and buses are still running.
Engine failure
*Poor weather conditions
Delay at transit spot

A saleswoman is talking to a customer about a house. What is not original?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q11.mp3
W: The hardwood floors you see here are completely original. The same goes for the architecture - those high ceilings and detailed moldings are a testament to the craftsmanship of that era. However, the furniture you see isn't original. It was replaced a few years ago.
Floor
*Furniture
Architecture

Listen to a weather forecast. Where will the weather be best?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q12.mp3
W: The weather down south isn't looking too great - strong winds and heavy rain. The west will have decent weather with clear skies and mild temperatures. However, the best weather can be found in the east, where we're expecting sunny skies and perfect temperatures.
In the south
In the west
*In the east

Adam is calling his friend. When will he need the computer?
AUDIO: audio/t4_q13.mp3
W: Hey James, it's Adam! I'm happy to let you borrow mine on Tuesday. Just make sure to take good care of it! But I need it back by Friday because I have a group presentation on Saturday.
Tuesday
*Friday
Saturday

lt4-p2.title: Ghép người nói
lt4-p2.instr: Four people are talking about doing arts. Match each speaker with what they say.
lt4-p2.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Doing as a social activity | Doing arts with children | Doing arts as part of the job | Doing arts alone
Speaker A = Doing as a social activity
AUDIO: audio/t4_q14_1.mp3
W: I love when people come together to create something - it's not just about the art itself but about connecting with each other. Ideas bounce around, and suddenly, new ones come to life. Art becomes a shared experience, bringing us all together.
Speaker B = Doing arts with children
AUDIO: audio/t4_q14_2.mp3
W: Kids are so fearless with art. They jump in, without worrying about mistakes, making everything feel magical. Teaching them is a reminder that creativity should be free and fun.
Speaker C = Doing arts as part of the job
AUDIO: audio/t4_q14_3.mp3
W: Art is part of my work, so it comes with structure - deadlines, clients, and goals. It's different from personal art because I'm balancing my ideas with what's needed for the project. But there's a thrill in that challenge.
Speaker D = Doing arts alone
AUDIO: audio/t4_q14_4.mp3
W: Art, for me, is a quiet, personal thing. It's my time to focus inward, away from distractions. I don't need anyone else there, it's just me and my thoughts. Creating alone brings a peace where I can explore and express freely.

lt4-p3.title: Ai có ý kiến này?
lt4-p3.instr: A man and a woman are talking about urban farming. Decide whose opinion matches each statement: the man, the woman, or both. You can listen twice.
lt4-p3.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t4_q15.mp3
M: Urban farming will take up land that could be used for accommodation.
W: Unused spaces that are too small for housing can be converted into farming areas. If done right, this could be both beneficial and visually attractive.
M: Rural farming is still a more practical option.
W: That's true, and I agree. But changes need to happen.
lt4-p3.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Man | Woman | Both
Living space is more important than farming space = Man
Farming space is appealing = Woman
Farming space will benefit the urban economy = Woman
Farming space is in need of more food = Both

lt4-p4a.title: Bài nói 1
lt4-p4a.instr: Listen to a critic talking about a newly broadcast TV series.
lt4-p4a.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t4_q16.mp3
W: A famous TV series called Mystery City was recently broadcasted, and it caught the audience's attention from the start. Beyond just entertaining, Mystery City has also helped its network reach new customers. The show attracted a diverse audience, including younger viewers.
lt4-p4a.body:
What happened to the TV series?
It didn't receive enough investment in the early stage.
It was overlooked by critics.
*It caught the audience's attention from the start.

According to the expert, what is the series' potential?
New seasons will be produced due to great demand.
It inspires young filmmakers to follow a new movie-making style.
*It can help reach new customers.

lt4-p4b.title: Bài nói 2
lt4-p4b.instr: Listen to an advertising expert talking about the advertising industry.
lt4-p4b.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t4_q17.mp3
W: Many TV series have been damaged by overexposure. In terms of sports, overexposure can generate negative publicity for the sport itself. Fans may start to associate their favorite teams and players with annoying advertisements rather than the thrilling action on the field.
lt4-p4b.body:
What does the expert say about the negative side of advertising?
*Series are damaged by overexposure.
Advertisements might sometimes be repetitive, which is annoying.
Advertising costs the same amount of money to produce a movie.

In what way can advertising affect sports?
They help to attract more fans.
They can boost ticket sales and sales of sports-related items.
*They can generate negative publicity for the sport.

lt5-p1.title: Nghe và chọn chi tiết
lt5-p1.instr: Nghe từng đoạn và chọn đáp án đúng. Mỗi đoạn được nghe tối đa 2 lần.
lt5-p1.body:

AUDIO: audio/t5_q1.mp3
W: Attention, all passengers! The 10:30 train to Greenfield is now arriving at Platform 2. Please make sure you have your ticket ready before boarding. This train will stop at River Station and Oakwood before reaching its final destination.
*Platform 2
Platform 5
Platform 8

An artist is talking about her job. What is the difference in her job?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q2.mp3
W: Hello, my name is Sarah, and I'm an artist. My job is very fun, but I work irregular hours, sometimes late at night or on weekends. When I have inspiration, I paint for many hours without a break.
She works from 9 to 5
She doesn't work on weekends
*She works irregular hours

Listen to a conversation between the teacher and a parent. What will the father do?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q3.mp3
W: Teacher: I know a private tutor who works well with children. She can provide extra help and support. Father: That sounds like a good idea! Can you give me her contact information?
Enroll him in summer school
*Arrange private classes for his son
Talk to the principal

A woman is talking about her weekends. What did she do last week?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q4.mp3
W: My weekends are not always the same. Last weekend, I stayed at home and enjoyed some quiet moments with a book. I also watched a few movies and cooked a nice dinner for myself.
Went hiking
*Stayed at home
Attended a party

A teacher and a student are talking about transportation. How does the teacher go to school?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q5.mp3
W: Student: I usually take the bus. Teacher: I understand. I walk to school every day. It helps me get some exercise, and I enjoy the fresh air. I often walk with a few other teachers.
He drives
He takes the bus
*He walks

Anne is calling her daughter Sally. What does Anne need?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q6.mp3
W: Hi Sally, it's Mom. Can you stop by the store on your way home? We're out of eggs, and I need some to finish baking the cake. Thanks, sweetie!
*Eggs
Bread
Milk

A mom is talking to her son. What does he like to study?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q7.mp3
W: Hey sweetheart. Your art project looks amazing, you're really talented. I love how you used all those bright colors. You always do such a great job with your drawings. But remember, you also need to spend some time on math and science.
*Art
Science
History

A woman is talking about her family's holidays. What did the family do last year?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q8.mp3
W: This year, my family and I are going to the beach for our holiday. Last year, we went camping on the mountain, which was fun, but this time we wanted to do something different.
Traveled abroad
*Camping
Went to the beach

A man is talking about how he goes to work. Why does he prefer traveling by train?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q9.mp3
W: After thinking about all the choices, I decided to travel by train. It's practical because it's on time, and I can relax during the trip. Plus, the station is close to my office!
It's cheaper than biking
*It's practical
It's faster than flying

Listen to the instructions of a university. Where is the main office?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q10.mp3
W: Welcome to our university! If you need help with anything, the main office is on the first floor of the center campus building. There, you can ask about classes, schedules, or anything else.
On the third floor
*On the first floor
In the basement

A woman is talking about shopping places. Where is she going to go shopping?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q11.mp3
W: I love shopping, and there are so many places to choose from in our city. This time, I'm excited to check out the new shopping center that just opened. I've heard it has everything I need in one place!
At the downtown market
*At a new shopping center
At the mall

A tour guide is making an announcement. Why was the tour canceled?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q12.mp3
W: The weather is perfect and transportation is not a problem, everything is ready for our trip. Unfortunately, we don't have enough people for the tour today. Because of this, we have to cancel the tour.
*Not enough people
Bad weather
Transportation problems

A man is talking about his job. What does the man want to do next?
AUDIO: audio/t5_q13.mp3
W: I used to be a chef. After that I became a history teacher. Teaching was rewarding, but I wanted to try something new. Now, I want to become a writer! I have many ideas for stories in my mind.
*Become a writer
Become a chef again
Start teaching history again

lt5-p2.title: Ghép người nói
lt5-p2.instr: Four people are talking about online shopping. Match each speaker with what they say.
lt5-p2.body:
LỰA CHỌN: It saves time. | It is cheaper. | Products are delivered. | There are more choices.
Speaker A = It saves time.
AUDIO: audio/t5_q14_1.mp3
W: I've always been a bit short on time, especially with my busy work schedule. That's why I prefer shopping online - it really helps me save so much time. Instead of spending hours in stores, I can quickly browse and make my purchase in just a few clicks.
Speaker B = It is cheaper.
AUDIO: audio/t5_q14_2.mp3
W: For me, one of the main reasons I shop online is because it's usually more affordable. I've noticed that many online stores offer discounts and I can often find cheaper prices than I would in physical shops.
Speaker C = Products are delivered.
AUDIO: audio/t5_q14_3.mp3
W: The biggest advantage of shopping online for me is the fact that I don't have to leave my house. I love how products get delivered straight to my doorstep, especially when I order something heavy or large.
Speaker D = There are more choices.
AUDIO: audio/t5_q14_4.mp3
W: What I love about shopping online is the incredible variety of products available. When I go to a store, I'm limited to what's in stock, but online, there's so much more choice. I can find different brands, styles, and even hard-to-find sizes.

lt5-p3.title: Ai có ý kiến này?
lt5-p3.instr: A man and a woman are talking about the local center that was recently opened. Decide whose opinion matches each statement: the man, the woman, or both. You can listen twice.
lt5-p3.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t5_q15.mp3
M: I believe exhibitions should be different. They need to show new ideas, not just the same old things.
W: Sometimes, it's nice to celebrate our traditions, even if they are losing significance.
W: I worry that the local festivals will disappear soon.
W: Let's not forget how important schools are in keeping our traditions alive.
lt5-p3.body:
LỰA CHỌN: Man | Woman | Both
Exhibitions should be different and diverse = Man
Traditional customs are gradually losing their significance = Both
Local festivals will disappear in the near future = Woman
Schools are important in shaping future generations = Woman

lt5-p4a.title: Bài nói 1
lt5-p4a.instr: Listen to a TV producer sharing his thoughts on the latest scripts for a new show.
lt5-p4a.audio:
AUDIO: audio/t5_q16.mp3
W: The biggest gap right now is that we haven't adequately explored the characters' backstories through their dialogue. Market demand and tight broadcast deadlines are pushing us to rush through the script development cycle. When you cut corners on editing and refinement, the final quality of the project takes a hit.
lt5-p4a.body:
What does the producer think about the dialogues in the new show?
*The characters' backgrounds are not adequately explored
They seem unrealistic.
They reflect real-life conversations well.

How is the current industry demand affecting the quality of script production?
It is allowing for more thorough script development.
It is leading to more innovative ideas.

sp2-01.part: Part 2 · Describe, express opinion, give reasons
sp2-01.title: Bộ 1
sp2-01.instr: Mô tả bức ảnh rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp2-01.body:
CÂU HỎI: Describe the picture | 45
BÀI MẪU: This is the first time I have seen such an awesome picture as the one on the screen. When I first look at it, I can see a family of three: a dad, a mom, and their daughter.
The dad is sitting at the dining table; he appears to be around 35 years old with a thick beard. It seems like he is having breakfast, and there is a glass of orange juice on the table. The mom looks to be about 30 years old, with a beautiful face, a shining smile, and curly blonde hair. She is holding a book, seemingly reading a story to her little daughter, who is lying in her lap listening. The girl looks to be around 10 years old, with a bright face, and she is intently focused on her mom’s storytelling.
Besides, it’s not difficult to see that they are in their cozy home, with everything neatly arranged and plenty of space for sunlight to come in. The picture reminds me of my own family when I was a child. Back then, I lived close to my parents and enjoyed spending weekends together. Now, I have moved to the city for work and can only be with my family during major holidays.
CÂU HỎI: Why is it important to play with children? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Playing with children is undeniably important. I believe it is crucial for parents and children to spend quality time together because it helps build a natural, healthy, and emotional bond that can last a lifetime. When parents and children engage in activities together, it also creates beautiful and lasting memories. Moreover, spending time together teaches children how to interact with others by developing their respect and empathy. Finally, it allows parents to guide and discipline their children if needed, which is essential for helping them grow into responsible and good citizens in the future.
CÂU HỎI: How should parents spend time together with their children? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Parents should spend time with their children both outdoors and indoors. Outdoor activities can include playing sports like badminton or tennis, going for a walk, or having a picnic. Indoor activities might involve playing puzzles, watching TV, or reading books together.
In Vietnam, parents are often busy during the day, but they try to spend time with their kids in the evenings. That’s why families usually have dinner together, which provides a great opportunity to connect and share their day. Additionally, parents often help their children with homework, study English, or learn other subjects, which supports their children's education and development.

sp2-02.part: Part 2 · Describe, express opinion, give reasons
sp2-02.title: Bộ 2
sp2-02.instr: Mô tả bức ảnh rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp2-02.body:
CÂU HỎI: Describe the picture | 45
BÀI MẪU: This is the first time I have seen such a lively and joyful picture like this.
When I look at this image, I can see a group of four friends sitting together at an outdoor café. The man on the left is holding a smartphone, and he might be showing something funny to the others. Everyone is laughing loudly, especially the person with curly hair who is standing and leaning forward.
They look relaxed and cheerful, which suggests they are enjoying a pleasant moment together. The background seems to be a city street, so I think they are hanging out in a busy urban area.
This picture makes me feel happy because it reminds me of the importance of spending quality time with close friends.
CÂU HỎI: Do you often spend time drinking coffee with your friend? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Yes, I do enjoy spending time drinking coffee with my friends whenever I can. It's a great way to relax and catch up on each other's lives. We usually meet at a cozy café where we can sit and chat for hours. I find that these moments are not just about the coffee but also about the connection and the conversations we share. Whether we're discussing something serious or just having a laugh, it's always a pleasant experience that helps us unwind and strengthen our friendships.
CÂU HỎI: Do people in your country have this habit? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Yes, drinking coffee with friends is a very common habit in Vietnam. In fact, coffee culture is a significant part of social life here. People often gather at local coffee shops to chat, relax, or even work. These gatherings are not just about the coffee itself but about spending quality time together. Whether it's a morning coffee before starting the day, an afternoon break, or an evening chat, meeting up over coffee is a cherished tradition in Vietnam. The atmosphere in Vietnamese coffee shops is usually very relaxed, making it an ideal setting for socializing and enjoying each other's company.

sp2-03.part: Part 2 · Describe, express opinion, give reasons
sp2-03.title: Bộ 3
sp2-03.instr: Mô tả bức ảnh rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp2-03.body:
CÂU HỎI: Describe the picture | 45
BÀI MẪU: This is the first time I have seen such an awesome picture as I can see on the screen. When I first look at this, I can see a teacher standing at the front of a classroom, teaching a group of students who are sitting and facing her.
She’s about 30 years old with a beautiful face, a warm, shining smile, and dark hair. She’s wearing a light yellow cardigan over a white top, paired with a dark skirt. It’s not difficult to see that she’s in a classroom because I can see students sitting at desks, with notebooks and other school supplies in front of them. She seems to be on top of the world as she’s confidently engaging with her students, possibly explaining a lesson or guiding them through an activity.
The picture reminds me of my own school days, particularly a favorite teacher who always made learning enjoyable, just like the woman in the picture.
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about the last time you studied something in class | 45
BÀI MẪU: The last time I studied something in class was just yesterday. I attended a physics lecture with my university classmates, and it was taught by my favorite professor, Ms. Lee. I found the lesson particularly engaging because Ms. Lee used real-world examples to explain the concept of gravity. She even conducted some practical demonstrations, which really helped to bring the theory to life. It made the topic much more comprehensible and enjoyable for me.
CÂU HỎI: How can teachers make the lessons interesting? | 45
BÀI MẪU: In my point of view, teachers can make lessons more interesting in a few key ways. One effective approach is to incorporate interactive activities, such as mini games with small rewards, which can capture students' attention and make learning more enjoyable. Another strategy is to integrate multimedia elements like videos or images, which can enhance the lesson by providing visual and auditory stimulation, making the material more engaging. Additionally, linking the content to real-world examples or current events can help students understand the relevance of the lesson, keeping them more motivated and invested in the subject matter.

sp2-04.part: Part 2 · Describe, express opinion, give reasons
sp2-04.title: Bộ 4
sp2-04.instr: Mô tả bức ảnh rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp2-04.body:
CÂU HỎI: Describe the picture. | 45
BÀI MẪU: This is the first time I've seen such an interesting photo of people traveling like the one I see on the screen. When I first look at it, I see a group of seven friends, with the most notable being a girl at the center of the picture. She's wearing headphones and is deeply immersed in the music. She's about 22 years old, with a beautiful face, a radiant smile, and blonde hair. A genuine smile lights up her face as she loses herself in the melodies. She's wearing a simple checkered shirt. Next to her, I can see her travel companions who are also on their journey. The yellow window curtains give off a warm glow, and the golden light outside the window looks like a sunset. They might have traveled a long way, and their destination seems to be close. This picture reminds me of the company trip last weekend. We also traveled by car from Hanoi to Dai Lai, and it was an exciting journey.
CÂU HỎI: Tell me about the last time you traveled with a group? | 45
BÀI MẪU: The last time I traveled with a group was just last weekend. My three close friends and I traveled from Hanoi to the Dai Lai Eco-tourism Area. The place has a stunning natural setting with a clear blue lake, picturesque scenery, and fresh air from the lush green forests that stretch out around it. The landscape there is absolutely breathtaking. We were able to relax and enjoy many exciting activities on Dai Lai
Lake.
CÂU HỎI: What are the benefits of traveling with a group? | 45
BÀI MẪU: In my opinion, traveling with a group offers many benefits. Firstly, it
deepens relationships as you share new experiences and create lasting memories together. It also allows you to venture off the beaten path safely, uncovering hidden gems with the support of friends. Additionally, you can try new things and share strengths, making the journey smoother and more enjoyable. Group travel provides a sense of security, ensures you get better photos, and allows you to celebrate cuisine together. Lastly, it’s more fun, as you can relax, enjoy diverse perspectives, and form new friendships along the way.

sp2-05.part: Part 2 · Describe, express opinion, give reasons
sp2-05.title: Bộ 5
sp2-05.instr: Mô tả bức ảnh rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp2-05.body:
CÂU HỎI: Describe the picture. | 45
BÀI MẪU: This is the first time I've seen such a natural and fascinating moment on screen. When I first look at this, I see an outdoor interview. There are two men and one woman. In the center of the picture is a woman about 30 years old with a beautiful face, a bright smile, and curly blonde hair. She is interviewing the man in the suit standing opposite her. He looks about 35 years old and seems to be a businessman. Next to them is another man in a light blue shirt, who is intently focused on the camera, capturing the interview. It's easy to see that they are in front of a glass building with green architecture. This seems to be the headquarters of the man in the suit, suggesting that he has successfully pursued environmentally friendly business practices. This is something to be very proud of and worth sharing with many people.
CÂU HỎI: Do you prefer reading newspapers or watching news? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Both forms of news consumption have their unique features. Newspapers usually offer deeper analysis and more detailed reporting on issues. I can read at my own pace without being interrupted by ads. On the other hand, watching the news has its own conveniences. Television and online news broadcasts can deliver breaking news as it happens. Seeing images and videos makes the news more engaging and easier to understand. It's often simpler for people to absorb information through visuals and sound. News anchors and reporters can add a personal touch and sometimes provide insights or context. Because of my busy schedule and limited free time, reading newspapers isn't as convenient as watching the news. That's why I prefer watching news on my phone, even when I'm on the move or waiting in public places.
CÂU HỎI: Why do people need to watch the news? | 45
BÀI MẪU: In my opinion, there are many reasons why people need to watch the news. The first important reason is that it helps them stay updated on what is happening locally, nationally, and globally. This includes current events, politics, economics, weather, and more. Secondly, being aware of the latest developments helps people make informed decisions in their personal and professional lives. This can range from understanding economic trends that might affect their finances to knowing about political changes that could impact their community. Next is the awareness of emergencies such as natural disasters, public health alerts, and safety warnings. This helps people take necessary precautions and stay safe.  Additionally, news programs often include stories about cultural events, scientific discoveries, and human interest pieces that broaden viewers' understanding of the world and different cultures. Finally, some people find news programs entertaining and enjoy the variety of stories, interviews, and human interest pieces that are often included.

sp3-01.title: Bộ 1
sp3-01.instr: Mô tả và so sánh hai bức ảnh, rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp3-01.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me what you see from the two pictures? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Wow, actually these two pictures are really interesting, and both of them are related to how families spend their leisure time together. When I look at the first picture, it’s quite easy to see a mother and her daughter playing a video game together. They seem to be in their living room, sitting comfortably on a sofa. Both of them look very happy and energetic. While the first picture feels lively and modern, the second picture shows a family playing a traditional game of chess around a table. The atmosphere here appears much calmer and more relaxed, and they seem to be enjoying a quiet moment of face-to-face interaction. Personally, I prefer the second one because it encourages closer family bonding without technology.
CÂU HỎI: Compare the two activities. Which one do you think is more suitable? | 45
BÀI MẪU: In my opinion, both activities help children develop different skills, but I personally find playing chess more suitable. Playing video games helps children become familiar with technology and develop quick reactions and hand-eye coordination. However, chess requires much deeper thinking. Players need to observe carefully, be patient, and predict their opponent’s moves in order to build an effective strategy. Personally, I prefer playing chess because it helps me improve my perseverance, my ability to analyse situations, and my skill in finding solutions. These qualities are extremely useful and can be applied a lot in my own work.
CÂU HỎI: Do you think playing computer games is good for children? Why or why not? | 45
BÀI MẪU: I believe playing computer games can be good for children if it is properly controlled. On the positive side, some educational or strategic games can improve problem-solving skills, creativity, and hand-eye coordination. They can also help children relax after studying. However, if children spend too much time playing computer games, it may negatively affect their health, concentration, and social skills. Therefore, I think computer games are beneficial only when children play them in moderation and with guidance from parents.

sp3-02.title: Bộ 2
sp3-02.instr: Mô tả và so sánh hai bức ảnh, rồi trả lời các câu hỏi, mỗi câu khoảng 45 giây. Ảnh của đề không kèm theo; xem câu trả lời mẫu để biết nội dung ảnh.
sp3-02.body:
CÂU HỎI: Tell me what you see from the two pictures? | 45
BÀI MẪU: Wow, both of these pictures are really intriguing, I can't stop talking about them. In my view, they both depict leisure activities people engage in during their free time.
When I look at the first picture, it's easy to spot a man around 50 years old sitting and reading a newspaper. From what I can see, he seems to be relaxing in his garden, with a comfortable chair and the lush greenery surrounding him. It looks like he's enjoying some peaceful me-time.
On the other hand, the second picture presents a stark contrast. Here, we see a boy playing video games on a computer with a frustrated expression. It appears that he's immersed in a tense gaming session with teammates and opponents, wearing headphones to enhance the experience. Perhaps he's feeling a bit stressed due to the competition.
CÂU HỎI: Which one do you prefer? | 45
